explanation: The English article on the coup writes its background as the two years between: Mubarak resigned in February 2011 after eighteen days of mass demonstrations, the caretaker government approved an election law in July, a parliament was elected between December 2011 and January 2012, and Morsi won the presidential election of June 2012 to become the first democratically elected president of Egypt — the president the coup of 3 July 2013 removed.
